newsitem.title: USA: Costco says net income up 61 percent, sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Costco says net income up 61 percent, sales rise.

text.p: Warehouse retailer Costco Cos Inc. said Thursday it earned $66 million in the latest quarter, an increase of 61 percent over the year-ago period, on a 12 percent gain in sales.
Earnings per share increased 48 percent to 31 cents from 21 cents, easily beating Wall Street estimates of 27 cents..

Sales for the third quarter of fiscal 1997 rose to $4.75 billion from $4.24 billion during last year's quarter. On a comparable-sales basis, comparing results at warehouses open at least a year, net sales increased 10 percent.
The company, which operates 258 warehouse stores, said it took a pretax provision of $3.5 million for warehouse closing costs, or one cent per share on an after-tax basis.
That compared with a pretax provision of $6.0 million, or two cents per share on an after-tax basis, for store closing costs in the third quarter of the prior fiscal year.
The provisions primarily include estimated closing costs for certain stores that were or will be replaced by new warehouses.
For the first 36 weeks of fiscal 1997 sales increased 12 percent to $14.69 billion from $13.14 billion a year ago. Comparable-store sales during the period rose 9 percent.
The company reported net income of $195.5 million, or 92 cents per share, for the period, compared with profits of $162.3 million, or 80 cents a share a year ago.
The latest results were impacted by a $65 million pretax, non-cash charge in the first quarter, reflecting the company's adoption of the accounting standard for the impairment of long-term assets.
Before the effect of the charge, profits were $234.2 million, or $1.10 per share.
The year-to-date results also reflect an $8.5 million pretax provision for estimated warehouse closing costs, compared with a prior-year provision of $6.0 million.
The company operates 198 warehouse stores in the United States, 54 in Canada, five in Britain and one in Taiwan.
It also operates 13 warehouses in Mexico with a joint venture partner and has a license agreement for the operation of a membership warehouse in Seoul, Korea.

Expansion plans for the remainder of the fiscal year, which ends Aug. 31, are to open 5 additional warehouses, including the relocation of its New Rochelle, N.Y., warehouse to a larger and better-located facility.
